seatedToss.guidance: Tulama pa mesa, mutuadile mupira mukese mu tshibinda tshinene. Bala pa mpapa, pamu.
steps: Sapudisha tshibinda ne mpapa wa kubala, kanka utula pa mesa pakati penu.
Tulama bu kumeka, umue ku tshitoyi tshimue. Tuadilai kamue kamue mupira mukese, anyi kuleka kaka kakuamba kutuadila.
Mupira ukuanda mu muanda, muntu wakuadila ukubala tshibidi mu mutshi wende, pa mutshi wa muanda uyo.
Tangai pamu bimanyishila pa kuleka, bibidi, kadi. Kayi muntu ufuanela kubala nansha kimue.
Leka pa tshinyi tshimue muntu wakalala wende.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Tuadila kaka mupira wa mpala wa kubunda, anyi musoku wa mpala wa kupetula. Tulama pa mesa, kayi kutuadila ku mesu, ne muana mukulu udi pepi. Bintu bikese ke bikonda bua kukumina.
flags: Kayi ku bana ba pashi pa 3: bintu bikese
safety: Tuadila mupira wa mpala wa kubunda, anyi musoku wa mpala wa kupetula. Nkanga yoyi kuiona, bua kubula mabowo anyi mishoko idi mimanuka kutshiayi.
Biakudia, mabanji ne bintu bikuabu bikese ke bikonda bua kukumina. Bikale kure ne bana ba pashi ne muntu udi kuteka bintu mu nyuma.
Mu tshinyi tshimue, tulama pepi ne muntu mukulu, ne kulonda bu bulondi bua mukese, anyi bintu bidi kuteka mu nyuma.
Tulama pa mesa. Tuadila bu mpala ne buipi ku tshibinda pa mesa, kayi kuanda ku mesu.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Mpapa wapatshila: tshibinda tshia bibinda bisatu bibidi Pedipedi, Kati ne Kule, kutshidi kuanda ku mupata, ne mutshi wa kubala udi na tshitambu tshia muntu wa kuamba ne mitshi ya mabokoso mapeta a kila bibinda.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Tula mpapa pa mesa pakati penu. Mupira ukuanda mu tshibinda, bala bokoso mu tshitambu tshiende, pa mutshi wa tshibinda tshio.
seatedToss.print: Sapudisha tshibinda ne mpapa wa kubala

Bikale muswa pa tshiteo tshia bantu bonso bayuka.

coloring.guidance: Kosa pa langi, pashishe kosa pa tshitupa tshia tshimfuanyi.

conversationCards.guidance: Bala karte aka kulu. Kakwena mandamuna makanyine anyi mabi to.
conversationCards.bigPicture: Tshifanyi tshinene, mu muntu wa bingi
conversationCards.passNote: Muntu umue ne umue kadi ulekela.
conversationCards.groupTitle: Kupita kadi ya kulonda mu muntu wa bingi
conversationCards.groupSit: Tshiba pa tshinanzi, kuna bantu bonso bamone tshifanyi. Muntu udi ne kadi, kansi tshitoko tshinene, udi kutomina tshiambu ku tshimpala.
conversationCards.groupPass: Kadi pita kadi ku muntu wa tshiteo. Muntu umue ne umue ambe tshiambilu tshimue, mudi tshimue, pa tshifanyi, kadi tshipite.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Kupita kadi nkanda kukonzeka nasu. Muntu udi kuamba tshimue kayi, kadi kayi muntu muenza kuamba mbuangu ku mbiyi.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Mulongo wakupela pa kalata kakapite pa kibumba, nansha bantu bayikale bawuvua. Kakuena muntu utshinda. Bantu bakokeja kulekela kutuka padi.

photoPairs.guidance: Kosa pa foto, pashishe kosa pa idi ipetangana nayi.
photoPairs.intro: **Sungulayi foto 2 too ne ku 6** mu tshiamu etshi. Bidi bimueneka anu pa dibeji edi nkayadi ne kabiena bitekibua anyi bilamibua kukuabo to.
photoPairs.cleared: Foto yonsene ikadi miumushibue pa dibeji edi.
photoPairs.atLeastTwo: Nudi nulombibue bua kusungula foto ibidi anyi kupita apu.
photoPairs.usingFirst: Tudi tuenza mudimu ne foto {max} tsa kumpala.

skipped.other: Mfishe {count} kayivua foto itudi mua kuleja to.

photoPairs.empty: Foto yenu neyisanganyike muaba ewu, yonso misangu ibidi.

pictureBingo.guidance: Anji tshapayilayi tuarte. Pashishe lejayilayi tshiamu etshi pa skrini munene unudi nende.
pictureBingo.start: Kosa pa "Tshimfuanyi tshidi tshilonda" bua kubikila tshimfuanyi tshia kumpala.

calmBreathing.guidance: Puyila munda padi mudingilu uvula, pashishe upatulelu padiye ukepela. Bidi biimana nkayabi kunyima kua bipuapuila bisambombo.
calmBreathing.started: Bidi bibange. Puyila munda padi mudingilu uvula.
calmBreathing.finished: Kuvua bipuapuila bitekete bisambombo. Nudi mua kubangulula dîba dionso dinudi basue.

storyChain.guidance: Tuma bi mukonda: umue wa kulonga shimba umue, yongela tshifwanyi tshilondela.
storyChain.passNote: Lombola shimba yenu mu kulonga. Kakuena kukonsa nansha kubikila. Muntu kakuyisanka kupita.
storyChain.full: Shimba uena bifwanyi 8 bionso. Yanka nkatu yonso, nansha tandika shimba mupya.

cards.prompt: Munya kaye ka mu nzubu wa lukuata kanudi banange bikole?
Ngato kayi unudi mua kusungula bua tshibilu tshia disanka?
Tulongolwelayi bualu bua tshimuma anyi gato ka mamuma kanudi banange.
Nudi basue kunua tiyi anyi kafe mushindu kayi?
Mbintu kayi bidi bienza biakudia bia pa dinda bilenga menemene?
Kukadi kumpala kukapuila tshimuma pa mutshi watshi anyi?
Bikole ku buuki anyi kubaba, nudi banange kayi kupita kukuabu?
Tshiakudia kayi tshidi tshinuvuluija tshikondo tshia munya ne disanka?
Tulongolwelayi bualu bua nzubu umwe u nuakavua banange kusombelamu.
Mmuaba kayi unudi basue kusomba bua kuikisha?
Nudi basue kuenza tshinyi dilolo padi bintu bipole?
Mbintu kayi bia mushinga unudi mua kulama mu kashibo ka pa buaku?
Muntu kayi unudi mua kubikila bua kunua nende lupanza lua tiyi?
Nudi basue kuenza tshinyi dituku didi mvula uloka?
Mmaloba kayi anudi mua kukuna mu budimi?
Tulongolwelayi bualu bua mutshi anyi mpata muaba u mudi banange.
Ntshinyi tshidi tshisankisha bikole panudi mu budimi?
Nudi banange maloba a langi kayi?
Nudi basue kuikala ne bisoso bidi munda mua nzubu anyi?
Dituku dilenga dia munya dionso didi bimpe mushindu kayi kuudi?
Tulongolwelayi bualu bua mbua unuvua bamanye.
Tusumu anyi mbua, anyi kakuena nansha umue? Ntshinyi tshinudi banange kudibu?
Tunyanyi kayi tunudi numona anyi numvua pambelu?
Kukadi kumpala kuya kukuata mishipa, anyi kulama mishipa mu tshisolo?
Munyama kayi mulenga kupita bonso unuvua bamone?
Tulongolwelayi bualu bua mashinyi anuvua banange.
Nudi basue kupitshisha dituku ku luela lua mayi anyi ku mikuna?
Nudi basue kuya kwendakana ne kakinga kuweba kumpala?
Bu nuenu mua kuburuka mu lupepele kuulu kua muaba kampanda, muaba kayi unudi mua kusungula?
Muluendu kayi luakunusankisha bimpe?
Mmudimu kayi unuvua basue kuenza bikole?
Ntshisankisho kayi tshinudi mua kupitshisha natshi mêba a bungi?
Mbualu kayi buvua bantu banumanyine nabu bua kulongolola anyi kuluka?
Mmuoyo kayi unudi mua kupeshilangana nsonga udi ubanga mudimu?
Mmusambu kayi udi unusankisha bua kutua mikolo panshi?
Ntshinyi tshidi tshivuija feti kuikala ya nsombelu muimpe?
Mmwimbi kayi unudi basue kuteleja misambu yende?
Tshilambu anyi filme kayi tshinudi basue kutangila kabidi?
Ntshinyi tshinudi banange bikole mu tshikondo tshia munya?
Ntshinyi tshidi tshinusankisha padi mabeji apoloka ku mitshi?
Ntshinyi tshia lutulu tshinudi basue kuenza dilolo dia mashika?
Bimanyinu kayi bia kumpala bidi binuleja ne tshikondo tshia mvula ne lupuishi bidi bibanga?
Mwele wa mashika, mvula anyi munya wa dîba: nudi basue kayi?
